basic_info.description: Welcome to 266 Staples Avenue, an exquisitely renovated home nestled in the vibrant Sunnyside Neighborhood of San Francisco. This sophisticated residence offers 3 bedrooms and 3 modern bathrooms within approximately 1,350 square feet of beautifully designed living space. The open kitchen, featuring brand new stainless steel appliances, is perfect for culinary enthusiasts.    Enjoy the abundant natural light that fills the home, complemented by recessed lighting throughout for a warm ambiance. Modern conveniences include a Nest thermostat and a new HVAC system, ensuring comfort and energy efficiency year-round. Every detail has been meticulously updated, from the all-new electrical and plumbing to the windows, providing a seamless living experience. Situated on a generous 2,809 square foot flat lot, perfect for for outdoor enjoyment. Located close to City College and public transportation, freeway and restaurant and shopping.
